population.value: Adults (≥18 years) not receiving drug treatment for osteoporosis
population.quote: Randomised controlled trials comparing calcium, vitamin D, or combined supplementation with placebo or no treatment in adults (≥18 years) not receiving drug treatment for osteoporosis.

sample_size.quote: This review included 69 trials involving 153 902 participants.

intervention.value: Calcium, vitamin D, or combined supplementation
intervention.quote: Randomised controlled trials comparing calcium, vitamin D, or combined supplementation with placebo or no treatment

comparator.quote: Randomised controlled trials comparing calcium, vitamin D, or combined supplementation with placebo or no treatment

primary_findings.quote: little to no effect was found from use of calcium supplements (11 trials, 9067 participants; risk ratio 0.91, 95% confidence interval 0.81 to 1.01; moderate certainty)
vitamin D supplements (36 trials, 92 045 participants; 1.00, 0.95 to 1.06; high certainty)
combined supplementation (15 trials, 51 126 participants; 0.91, 0.84 to 0.99; high certainty)

limitations_stated.value: Evidence for high risk patients or those requiring residential care was limited for many outcomes for calcium monotherapy and for combined supplementation.
limitations_stated.quote: Evidence for high risk patients or those requiring residential care was limited for many outcomes for calcium monotherapy and for combined supplementation.
